51956.author: jprendi
51956.body:
#### PR description:

This PR:

1) separates `hltScoutingDqmOffline` into `hltDqmScoutingAndReco` and `hltDqmOnlyScouting`, such that we could run `hltDqmOnlyScouting` for offline DQM analysis on HLT Scouting Collections without needing prompt results

2) introduces `onlinehlt4vector`, such that we can run the online hlt dqm client in an offline analysis

#### PR validation:

This PR was prepared in `CMSSW_16_1_X_2026-09-20-0000`. We can now run the workflows for example like:

```
cmsDriver.py step2 -s DQM:hltDqmOnlyScouting \
	     --conditions 160X_dataRun3_NGT_v6 \
             --datatier DQMIO \
             -n 100 \
             --eventcontent DQMIO \
             --geometry DB:Extended \
             --era Run3_2026 \
             --filein $ALL_FILES \
             --fileout file:step2.root \
             --nThreads 24 \
             --python_filename dqm.py \
             --no_exec
```

and 

```
cmsDriver.py step2 -s DQM:onlinehlt4vector \
	     --conditions 160X_dataRun3_NGT_v6 \
             --datatier DQMIO \
             -n 100 \
             --eventcontent DQMIO \
             --geometry DB:Extended \
             --era Run3_2026 \
             --filein $ALL_FILES \
             --fileout file:step2.root \
             --nThreads 24 \
             --python_filename dqm.py \
             --no_exec
```

with the subsequent standard harvesting.

Verbatim backport of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51966
51956.title: Introducing new offline DQM sequences for HLT [16_1_X]

51986.author: mmusich
51986.body:
backport of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51985

#### PR description:

PR  https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51879 accidentally broke the unit tests for the the `ngt` and `scouting` dqm online clients ([ex log](https://cmssdt.cern.ch/SDT/cgi-bin/logreader/el8_amd64_gcc13/CMSSW_16_1_X_2026-09-25-2300/unitTestLogs/DQM/Integration#/19336-19336)) as the online beamspot is directly provided in the client itself, so there is no need to alter the input label.

https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/001f73040a537ea8cfb197046bb2b46d3a4dead3/DQM/Integration/python/clients/ngt_dqm_sourceclient-live_cfg.py#L59-L60

https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/001f73040a537ea8cfb197046bb2b46d3a4dead3/DQM/Integration/python/clients/scouting_dqm_sourceclient-live_cfg.py#L44-L45

#### PR validation:

```bash
scram b runtests_TestDQMOnlineClient-ngt_dqm_sourceclient 
scram b runtests_TestDQMOnlineClient-scouting_dqm_sourceclient
```

now run fine.

Verbatim backport of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51985, will be backported further down to `CMSSW_16_0_X`.
